Sample.evidence_source: The aim of the present research was to gain insight, through the use of focus groups, into the individual experiences of patients who attempt suicide, in order to better understand, the causal reasons and emotions connected to a suicide attempt, and risk and protective factors with regard to possible repeat attempts and the attitude towards the assistance they receive.
